title: Lamarr-Antheil frequency-hopping patent
summary: Film star Hedy Lamarr and composer George Antheil patented a radio guidance system that hopped between frequencies to resist jamming.
why: An early milestone for spread-spectrum radio.

unsung.contribution: Co-patented a frequency-hopping radio guidance system for torpedoes during the Second World War.
unsung.recognition: Similar technology entered service only after the patent expired; a 1997 award renewed attention to her as an inventor.
